Nivel de vechime: Nu se aplică
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Expleo is a global engineering, technology, and consulting service provider that partners with leading organizations to guide them through their business transformation, helping them achieve operational excellence and future-proof their businesses.
Expleo benefits from more than 50 years of experience developing complex products in automotive and aerospace, optimizing manufacturing processes, and ensuring the quality of information systems. Leveraging its deep sector knowledge and wide-ranging expertise in fields including AI engineering, digitalization, automation, cybersecurity and data science, the group’s mission is to fast-track innovation through each step of the value chain.
With a worldwide presence in 30 countries, our global footprint includes excellence centers around the world, including Romania since 1994.
 Responsibilities
 The Opportunity 
 Join the client's Secure Access Services team as a Cloud System Engineer Citrix, helping manage and transform secure access platforms from on-premise Citrix environments to Citrix Cloud. The role combines Citrix platform engineering, infrastructure troubleshooting, security-minded operations, and close collaboration with application packaging and infrastructure teams.
 Day-to-Day Responsibilities
 Manage on-premise Citrix platforms: NetScaler 1, CVAD, PVS, MCS, WEM and App Layering. 
 Deploy and manage cloud-based Citrix platforms as part of the Citrix Cloud transformation. 
 Troubleshoot Windows, Active Directory, virtualization, storage and network-related issues with the relevant teams. 
 Support roadmap items, client migrations and customer onboarding projects. 
 Execute changes, resolve incidents, handle user escalations and maintain technical documentation. 
 Participate in the single-point-of-contact rota and 24/7 stand-by rota for high-priority incidents. 
 Qualifications
 Academic/Bachelor level education or equivalent. 
 5+ years of relevant experience 
 Strong collaboration skills in international, multicultural environments. 
 Excellent English, written and verbal. 
 Drive, determination, patience and a quick-learning mindset. 
 Ability to engage with technical and non-technical stakeholders at all levels. 
 Excellent problem-solving, analytical, security-minded approach. 
 Essential Skills
 Strong expertise in Citrix technologies, including CVAD 2402 LTSR (or newer), Citrix Cloud and NetScaler. 
 Cloud & Hybrid infrastructure experience (Citrix or Azure, AWS, GCP). 
 Citrix image and environment management: PVS, MCS, App Layering and WEM. 
 Infrastructure knowledge: Windows Server 2019/2022, Active Directory, VMware, storage and network/firewall topics, Global Load Balancing. 
 Operational experience resolving user incidents, including stand-by support outside office hours. 
 Desired Skills
 Cloud certifications: GCP, AWS or Azure. 
 Cloud deployment technologies: Terraform and Puppet. 
 Infrastructure tooling: Trellix, Zabbix, Qualys and SentinelOne. 
 Citrix security and access: MFA on Citrix, OTP, n-factor authentication and Citrix Endpoint Analysis (EPA). 
 Compliance and security best practices in cloud environments. 
 What Do I Need Before I Apply
 Hybrid, a few days per month at the office. 
 CIM only
